# IDOSI Publications

> > IDOSI Publications is a scientific publisher offering peer-reviewed academic journals across agriculture, environmental sciences, entomology, genetics, pharmacology, zoology, and oceanography.

IDOSI publishes research from international contributors, with particular focus on regions including Egypt, Ethiopia, Turkey, Nigeria, Jordan, and Russia. The platform provides online access to journal archives, editorial boards, and indexing information across multiple scientific disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Academic publishing
- Peer-reviewed journals
- Agricultural sciences
- Environmental sciences
- Entomology research
- Genetics and molecular biology
- Pharmacology
- Oceanography and marine sciences
- Toxicological sciences
- Zoology
- Medicinal plants research
- Animal diseases
- Scientific indexing and abstracting
- Ethiopian research
- International scientific collaboration

## Core Journals

- [Academic Journal of Entomology](https://idosi.org/aje/aje.htm): AJE journal homepage - entomology research publication by IDOSI
- [International Journal of Genetics (IJG)](https://idosi.org/ijg/ijg.htm): IJG journal homepage - genetics research publication by IDOSI
- [American-Eurasian Journal of Toxicological Sciences](https://idosi.org/aejts/aejts.htm): AEJTS journal homepage - toxicological sciences peer-reviewed publication

## Editorial Leadership

- [AEJSR Editorial Board](https://idosi.org/aejsr/aejsrboard.htm): AEJSR editorial board - editors-in-chief & board members
- [AEJAES Editorial Board](https://idosi.org/aejaes/aejaesboard.htm): AEJAES editorial board - agricultural & environmental sciences editors
- [JTAS Editorial Board](https://idosi.org/jtas/board.htm): JTAS editorial board - statistics journal leadership & editors

## Journal Aims & Scope

- [AEJAES Aims & Scope](https://idosi.org/aejaes/aejaesas.htm): AEJAES journal aims & scope - agricultural & environmental sciences focus

## Online Archives & Volumes

- [JOMES Online Archives](https://idosi.org/jomes/online.htm): JOMES online archives - oceanography & marine environment publications
- [Global Journal of Pharmacology Online](https://idosi.org/gjp/online.htm): GJP online archives - pharmacology journal volume index
- [Advances in Biological Research Online](https://idosi.org/abr/online.htm): ABR online archives - biological research volume index by IDOSI

- [AJN Volume 11 Number 2, 2022](https://idosi.org/ajn/ajn11(2)22.htm): AJN Vol 11 No 2 (2022) - Ethiopia crop residue nutrition research
